text: The project covers seven protected areas across seven provinces, emphasizing ecotourism as a driver for conservation and livelihoods. It includes a comprehensive safeguards suite to manage social risks, such as resettlement and Indigenous Peoples' rights. The project also focuses on improving access and connectivity to make ecotourism sites and markets more reachable, with significant investments in infrastructure like roads and bridges.

metadata.solution_name: Cambodia Sustainable Landscape and Ecotourism Project (CSLEP)
